description: Composing a primitive-recursive function with a finite tuple of primitive-recursive functions of a common arity gives a primitive-recursive function.
signature:
Nat.Primrec'.comp {m n : ℕ} {f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ} (g : Fin n → List.Vector ℕ m → ℕ) :
  Nat.Primrec' f → (∀ (i : Fin n), Nat.Primrec' (g i)) → Nat.Primrec' fun a => f (List.Vector.ofFn fun i => g i a)
